User: Hey. Got something in the mail about missed calls?
Agent: Hey there, you probably got one of our Dialux postcards. I’m Linda.  

Yeah, we help small businesses stop losing customers from missed calls or after-hours calls.  
What kind of business are you running, and what’s been happening with your calls lately?
User: Already told ya - Dana Whitaker, me and my sister run Bright Smile Orthodontics up in Scottsdale. Front desk keeps missing calls.
Agent: Got it, Dana — Bright Smile Orthodontics with your sister in Scottsdale, and the front desk is missing calls. That’s really helpful context.

When are they slipping through the cracks most — during busy clinic hours, at lunch, or after hours? And are people complaining they can’t get through, or is it more that you see a bunch of missed-call notifications and no voicemails?
User: Already told ya - I'm slammed between patients. Best to reach me mornings before my first patient.
Agent: Makes sense, those pre-clinic hours are probably the only quiet ones you get.

Since you’re in Scottsdale, I’ll assume you’re on Arizona time year-round. What’s the best number to call you on in those mornings, and is it the same one you’re using right now?
User: Already told ya - My cell is four eight zero, five five five, oh one seven seven. And we're Arizona, so like Mountain time I guess.
Agent: Perfect, I’ve got your cell ending in 0177 and Arizona/Phoenix time, mornings before your first patient.

Last thing I need is an email so we can send over a quick overview without blowing up your phone—what’s the best email for you?
User: Already told ya - Email's dana@brightsmileortho.com if that's easier.
Agent: Thanks, Dana. I’ve got everything I need here. Your dedicated Dialux specialist will give you a call on your cell in the morning before your first patient to talk through how we can help catch those missed front-desk calls. Have a great rest of your day, and we’ll talk soon. Bye for now.
